# Granada

> Host-native software factory: from a one-line intent to a merge-ready draft pull request, run by the coding agent already in your CLI session (Claude Code, Codex or Cursor).

Granada owns the track: which station comes next, what each station must hand back, and the checks every answer has to pass. The host agent does the thinking at each agent station; Granada runs the tool stations (worktree, tests, ship checks, quality, mutation, drift, merge, forge) itself and records the run. Three tracks ship: `feature` (a change from a spec), `patch` (one bug fix) and `bootstrap` (a new project). Granada is a Node.js CLI and needs Node.js 22.12 or newer. After `granada host sync` in a git repository, the host has the commands `/granada-feature`, `/granada-patch` and `/granada-bootstrap`.

To set Granada up for a person, fetch the setup prompt below and follow its steps in order. Use the Traditional Chinese prompt when the person writes in Chinese.

## Setup

- [Setup prompt](https://daskinnyman.github.io/granada-release/setup-prompt.md): step-by-step instructions for a coding agent to install Granada and connect it to the host CLI
- [Setup prompt, Traditional Chinese](https://daskinnyman.github.io/granada-release/zh/setup-prompt.md): the same steps and commands; the agent replies to the person in Traditional Chinese (zh-Hant)
- [install.sh](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/daskinnyman/granada-release/main/install.sh): the curl installer; puts `granada` in ~/.local/bin; pin a version with GRANADA_VERSION
- [Release README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/daskinnyman/granada-release/main/README.md): Homebrew and curl install commands

## Optional

- [Landing page](https://daskinnyman.github.io/granada-release/): what Granada is, the tracks and their stations
- [Landing page, Traditional Chinese](https://daskinnyman.github.io/granada-release/zh/): the same page in zh-Hant
- [Releases](https://github.com/daskinnyman/granada-release/releases): published versions
